newsitem.title: USA: PacTel seeks ruling against Transworld Tel.
newsitem.headline: PacTel seeks ruling against Transworld Tel.

text.p: Pacific Telesis Group has filed an arbitration proceeding against Transworld Telecommunications Inc alleging breach of an agreement, Transworld said on Friday.
Transworld said that under a pact entered into in November 1995, PacTel agreed to acquire all of the stock of Wireless Holdings Inc and Videotron (Bay Area) Inc.
Transworld said it owns 50 percent of the outstanding stock of Wireless and 20 percent of the outstanding stock of Videotron.
In the arbitration proceeding filed in San Francisco, PacTel alleges that Transworld breached its obligations under the agreement.
The filing requests a declaration that Transworld and other respondents be ordered to complete the transactions under the agreement.
It also requests damages, interest, and lawyers' fees, Transworld said.
It said the proceeding was filed against it and its officers and directors F. Lorenzo Crutchfield and Lance D'Ambrosio.
The filing also names Wireless Holdings, Videotron (Bay Area) Inc, and Videotron USA Inc and all of its affiliates.
Videotron Groupe Ltee owns all of the outstanding stock of Wireless and Videotron (Bay Area) not owned by Transworld.
Transworld said it believes the arbitration proceeding is premature and it intends to defend itself.
